description.value: Private RV park on the South Thompson River just off the Yellowhead Highway, with shaded tent sites, flush washrooms, showers, and coin laundry; open April to mid-October at $39/night for unserviced tent sites.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was fully fetched and provides clear evidence for several amenities: water hook-ups, public toilets and showers, coin laundry, campground-wide Wi-Fi, and reservation acceptance by phone or email are all explicitly listed. OSM tags confirm the tourism=camp_site classification and fee=yes; the website corroborates the website URL but OSM carries no phone or address to cross-check. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, cyclist discounts, e-bike charging, bike tools, pump, camping fuel, or animal-safe food storage appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: No street address present in OSM tags or on the website; only turn-by-turn directional guidance is provided.
Phone number 250-828-2077 confirmed on website but absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating campground on the South Thompson River near Kamloops that accepts tent campers and offers showers, water, laundry, and Wi-Fi — a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Yellowhead corridor.

wow_evidence: public toilets and showers, coin laundry, campground-wide Wi-Fi
